q: Prime Minister Takaichi and President Xi Jinping hold a China-Japan summit
basis: China's economic retaliation, which began in November 2025, continues, and Takaichi has not retracted her remarks on a Taiwan contingency. The APEC meeting China hosts in November is the only opening.
rs: Announcements by the Japanese or Chinese foreign ministry (only a meeting that at least one of the two governments announces as a summit counts; a brief informal chat at the venue does not)
